business_rules.rule: It is obligatory that EMP-FNAME is set to "Millard".
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee first name (EMP-FNAME) is set to "Millard".

business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee last name (EMP-LNAME) is set to "Fillmore".

business_rules.rule: It is obligatory that EMP-HOURS is set to 19.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee hours (EMP-HOURS) is set to 19.

business_rules.rule: It is obligatory that EMP-HOURLY-RATE is set to 23.50.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee hourly rate (EMP-HOURLY-RATE) is set to 23.50.

business_rules.rule: If (EMP-HOURS >= 40), then it is obligatory that EMP-OT-RATE is set to .25.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If (the emp hours (EMP-HOURS) is at least 40), then it is obligatory that the emp ot rate (EMP-OT-RATE) is set to .25.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (EMP-HOURS >= 40)) AND (EMP-HOURS >= 50), then it is obligatory that EMP-OT-RATE is set to .50.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the employee hours (EMP-HOURS) is at least 40) and the employee hours is at least 50, then the employee overtime rate (EMP-OT-RATE) is set to 0.50.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (EMP-HOURS >= 40)) AND (NOT (EMP-HOURS >= 50)), then it is obligatory that EMP-OT-RATE is set to ZERO.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the employee hours (EMP-HOURS) is at least 40) and not (the employee hours is at least 50), then the employee overtime rate (EMP-OT-RATE) is set to 0.

business_rules.rule: It is necessary that EMP-PAY-WEEK is calculated as ( EMP-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE ) * ( 1 + EMP-OT-RATE ).
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee pay week (EMP-PAY-WEEK) is calculated as (the employee hours (EMP-HOURS) multiplied by the employee hourly rate (EMP-HOURLY-RATE)) multiplied by (1 plus the employee overtime rate (EMP-OT-RATE)).

business_rules.rule: If (EMP-HOURS > 150), then it is obligatory that EMP-REWARD is set to .50.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If (the emp hours (EMP-HOURS) is greater than 150), then it is obligatory that the emp reward (EMP-REWARD) is set to .50.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (EMP-HOURS > 150)), then it is obligatory that EMP-REWARD is set to ZERO.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the employee hours (EMP-HOURS) is greater than 150), then the employee reward (EMP-REWARD) is set to 0.

business_rules.rule: It is necessary that EMP-PAY-MONTH is calculated as ( EMP-PAY-WEEK * 4 ) * ( 1 + EMP-REWARD ).
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The employee pay month (EMP-PAY-MONTH) is calculated as (the employee pay week (EMP-PAY-WEEK) multiplied by 4) multiplied by (1 plus the employee reward (EMP-REWARD)).
